subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw add `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a supported permanent PluginRuntime API, or keep exact-profile usage access internal until provider-owned authorization policy has a stable SDK contract?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API over credentials and provider-specific usage semantics; correcting the mechanical defects does not decide the API’s supported scope, compatibility promise, or long-term owner boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow public API after repair
options.body: Keep the feature, but require a provider-owned exact-profile usage-auth seam, alias coverage, no-refresh failure guarantees, and real-provider proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the capability internal
options.body: Do not export the runtime method until an owner has a concrete bundled-plugin use case and a stable authorization contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow public API after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the feature, but require a provider-owned exact-profile usage-auth seam, alias coverage, no-refresh failure guarantees, and real-provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely decision owner for a new cross-cutting PluginRuntime and plugin-SDK contract.
